title: The Doorway
brief: Sevadars carry crates both ways between kitchen and washing. Make the wall passable. Budget ₹7,500. Finish in 60s.

mistri.brief: Crate dono taraf jaate hain, puttar. Soch ke darwaza banana.

hints.TOO_NARROW: Crate wala banda kitna chauda hai? Pehle naap lo.
hints.HEAD_ON_JAM: Aane wale aur jaane wale ek hi raste pe kyon?
hints.TIME_LIMIT: Dekho log kahan ruk rahe hain. Wahi gadbad hai.
hints.default: Ek baar dhyaan se dekho log kahan atakte hain.

insight.title: Separate the flows
insight.principle: When people move both ways, give each direction its own path.
insight.example: Metro stations have separate entry and exit gates, and busy restaurant kitchens have an IN door and an OUT door so waiters never collide.
insight.number: A 1.2 m doorway passes about 1.5 people a second, in one direction.
insight.quote: Ek darwaza, do raste? Takkar pakki hai, puttar.
